title: bug: CI never runs scripts/tests/daemon-json-cap.test.mjs or seat-registration.test.mjs (explicit node --test lists)
description: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs launcher node tests from explicit file lists (lines ~230-245, e.g. the prompt-cache-launcher step). `grep -n 'seat-registration\|daemon-json-cap' .github/workflows/*.yml` finds nothing, so both real-launcher-block suites (the daemon.json cap from task-ad0dc2e7, and the seat re-join from task-8333866a) never run in CI. Add them to an existing node --test step; Linux runs the bash leg, and the windows matrix job, if it runs them, adds PS 5.1/pwsh/Git Bash.
definitionOfDone: ci.yml runs node --test on scripts/tests/daemon-json-cap.test.mjs and scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs in at least the Linux job
Both suites pass on the CI runner(s) they are added to
